caption: The drawing contains several stylized objects arranged vertically on an aged, beige background. At the top is a cross shape outlined in red-brown with inner accents of gold-yellow and blue, and small gold-yellow lines radiating outward from the intersections. Below the cross is a bow-like structure with four looping segments, each outlined in blue and filled with a gold-yellow and red-brown pattern, converging at a circular center marked with alternating small triangles in red-brown and gold-yellow. Flanking the bow are two symmetrical gold-yellow shapes resembling wings, each with three rounded extensions and a red-brown accent near the tip. Centered below these shapes is a large circular medallion with blue, red-brown, and gold-yellow geometric patterns radiating from a central blue dot; the patterns include alternating triangular and flame-like motifs arranged in a ring, bordered by concentric circles in blue and red-brown. The artwork is composed primarily of gold-yellow, red-brown, and turquoise blue colors, with occasional small blue and gold-yellow lines or highlights, all set against a parchment-like textured background.
title: Santa Barbara Mission Doorway Design from the portfolio "Decorative Art of Spanish California"
